parsed.rationale: All 15 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on SwiftUI's `View` type, spread across 7 distinct packages (WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, app:iOS) and covering unrelated domain concerns such as glass-effect compatibility, overlay sheets, blend modes, gesture handling, HUD presentation, and status-bar styling. The structural signal is purely that each file happens to extend `View`; there is no shared field list (fields_or_signature is empty for all), no shared ancestor, and no Jaccard similarity score — the pipeline flagged these solely on the name-collision of the unnamed extension target. Extending `View` in the file where a component lives is idiomatic SwiftUI practice and these extensions encode entirely unrelated domain concepts whose coincidence is structural only.
